prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square seamless base-colour texture for the curved bark surface of dry oak firewood in a realistic game.
Create a flat orthographic photographic scan of weathered grey-brown oak bark, as if unwrapped from a modest 25 cm diameter seasoned log. Bark fibres and fine irregular fissures run vertically. Dense natural overlapping ridges, narrow broken plates and a few subtle small knots; thin dry bark, not huge chunky cork. Restrained neutral ash-grey and muted umber browns, with a little dusty tan in worn areas, matching dry pale oak end grain. Edge-to-edge texture, seamlessly repeating on all four edges, no borders or objects. Perfectly even diffuse illumination appropriate for an albedo map: no directional light, broad shading, baked cast shadow, specular shine or perspective. No wood boards, cut faces, leaves, moss, text or watermark. Sharp photographic microdetail and varied large-scale pattern without a grid. Square 2048px.
